verdict.rationale: Brevo's pricing page says Aura AI lets users "ask plain-language questions and get instant answers from your data," so the product itself offers AI-generated insights from user data. Proactive AI suggestions or recommendations drawn from that data are not documented. The one-click live-chat summarization is a related AI feature, but it summarizes conversations rather than providing data insights, so it gets no credit here. missing for 10: documented proactive AI-generated suggestions/recommendations from account data, in-depth first-party docs on Aura AI's scope and data coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask plain‑language questions and get instant answers from your data with Aura AI.
